newsitem.title: USA: HORSE RACING-Vt. group wants to reopen track for 10-day meet.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-Vt. group wants to reopen track for 10-day meet.

text.p: A group of businessmen from Pownal, Vt., said they want to bring back horse racing by using the closed Green Mountain Race Track.
The Pownal Fair Association this week asked the State Racing Commission to approve a ten-day meet for next summer.
The track featured horse and later greyhound racing before closing several years ago. Efforts to revive the track or bring in a casino have failed.

Another group is asking the commission to approve parimutuel harness racing at the Orleans County Fairgrounds in Barton next summer. The Northeast Kingdom Harness Racing Association wants to offer betting on live and simulcast races next July and August.
